articles.author: Kevin Whitelaw, Seth Fiegerman
articles.title: Anthropic CEO Says It’s Time to Slow AI Model Advances - Bloomberg.com
articles.description: Leaders of the world’s biggest artificial intelligence platforms said it’s time to slow the development pace of their most advanced — and most lucrative — models, citing escalating risks of the technology.
